subject: Dedicated GPU renewal & reserve expansion — PO amendment and billing alignment
messages:
From: Lena Morris <lena.morris@stellarnet.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@stellarnet.io
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: Dedicated GPU renewal + expansion — PO & billing alignment

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the renewal walkthrough last week. We're ready to proceed but need to fold an expansion into the renewal rather than a standalone PO. Summary of what Stellarnet is asking for: 

- Add 12 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs to our existing Dedicated pool (current pool: 24, target after renewal: 36).
- Keep the new capacity co-terminus with our existing renewal date (2027-03-31).
- Add a throughput guarantee for the combined pool: baseline 200k tokens/min sustained per pool with 99th-percentile latency target <= 300ms for 512-token requests.
- We expect a PO amendment that: (a) updates the committed units, (b) prorates the expansion from the effective date, and (c) aligns the billing schedule to quarterly invoices on calendar boundaries.

Attached: Stellarnet_SOW_renewal_v3.pdf and a draft PO (Stellarnet_PO_Draft_v2.xlsx). Procurement would like to see: a short amendment document they can attach to their AP system, and confirmation on whether Redwood can invoice on calendar quarters (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) instead of the renewal anniversary.

Can you confirm feasibility and any gaps (particularly re: SLA/throughput guarantees and billing cadence)?

Appreciate it — cc'ing our procurement alias.

Best,
Lena Morris
Head of Cloud Ops, Stellarnet
Lena.Morris@stellarnet.io

--- attachment stubs ---
1) Stellarnet_SOW_renewal_v3.pdf (pdf)
2) Stellarnet_PO_Draft_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Lena Morris <lena.morris@stellarnet.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@stellarnet.io
Date: 2026-10-25T11:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU renewal + expansion — PO & billing alignment

Lena — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. 

We can absolutely fold the 12 additional reserved GPUs into your renewal term as an amendment. High-level approach I recommend: 

1) PO amendment that increases committed GPUs from 24 -> 36 and sets the effective date to the date we sign the amendment; the term end remains 2027-03-31.
2) Proration: we will prorate the added capacity from the effective date to 2027-03-31 so you only pay for the days of additional capacity.
3) Billing cadence: we can support calendar-quarter invoicing but need finance sign-off for the collection window; copying Ben for confirmation.
4) SLA/throughput guarantee: we can commit to a throughput baseline and include an operational appendix detailing monitoring, outage credits, and escalation paths. Rishi — can you draft the appendix and include the 99th pct latency and credit trigger?

Next steps: I will prepare a PO amendment template and a short amendment cover letter your AP team can attach. If it's helpful, propose a quick 30-minute call tomorrow to align on invoicing dates and the exact effective date for prorate math.

Would 10:00 AM PT work for you?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Lena Morris <lena.morris@stellarnet.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@stellarnet.io
Date: 2026-10-26T15:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU renewal + expansion — PO & billing alignment

Thanks for the ping, Karthik. Quick finance confirmation and options for invoicing: 

Option A (preferred from finance): Quarterly calendar-aligned invoices (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) with Net30 payment terms. For an amendment signed between quarters we'll prorate the first invoice to cover the partial quarter.

Option B (alternate): Monthly invoices for the remainder of the term to simplify cash flow for Stellarnet.

Regarding charges and upsell accounting: we'll invoice the additional committed pool as a separate line item "Reserved GPU capacity - pool augmentation" and include a prorated line if the effective date is mid-quarter. For the SLA/credit language we'll need the appendix Rishi drafts; credits will be applied as a billing adjustment on the next invoice after a validated incident.

A few operational asks: please confirm the effective date you want on the amendment (the date we use for proration) and whether you want an initial setup fee for capacity provisioning. No objection to co-terming with the March 31, 2027 date.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

--- finance note ---
Suggested invoice label: "Stellarnet — Reserved GPU Augmentation (Oct 2026 - Mar 2027, prorated)"

From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@stellarnet.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Lena Morris <lena.morris@stellarnet.io>, procurement@stellarnet.io
Date: 2026-10-27T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU renewal + expansion — PO & billing alignment

Karthik — thanks. A few items from procurement before we finalize: 

- Calendar-quarter invoicing is fine as long as the first invoice is prorated to the quarter boundaries. We prefer invoices aligned to quarter start dates for AP processing.
- Can Redwood provide the SLA appendix (Rishi) and a short statement of throughput validation tests (how you'll validate the 200k tokens/min baseline)? Our infra team wants to see a runbook or test plan.
- We'd like to add a 10% service credit for sustained breach of the throughput guarantee (for any rolling 24-hour window) — we can negotiate exact thresholds in the appendix.
- Please include a single-line amended PO that our AP system can reconcile easily (we prefer a one-page amendment summary + signature page).

If you can send an amendment and the SLA appendix by Friday, procurement will route for internal approvals next week.

Thanks,
Carlos Vega
Senior Procurement Manager, Stellarnet
procurement@stellarnet.io

Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU renewal + expansion — PO & billing alignment

Carlos / Lena — great, thanks for the specificity. Confirming next steps and deliverables from Redwood: 

1) I'll attach a one-page PO amendment summary and signature page for your AP team (one-line summary + amended total committed units).
2) Rishi will circulate an SLA & throughput appendix (includes test plan/runbook, monitoring signals, 99th-pct latency SLA and credit thresholds).
3) Ben has confirmed we can do calendar-quarter invoicing with prorated first invoice; Net30 standard terms.
4) Proration math: we'll use the amendment effective date (date of signature) to prorate additional GPU charges to 2027-03-31 and apply on the first calendar-quarter invoice post-signature.

Action owners and ETA:
- Karthis (me): PO amendment one-pager and cover letter — EOD 2026-10-29.
- Rishi Malhotra: SLA appendix and throughput test plan — draft by 2026-10-29, final by 2026-11-02.
- Ben Carter: billing label and invoice template — draft by 2026-10-30.

If Stellarnet is happy with that timeline we'll proceed and aim to have signed amendment + appendices in hand by November 5 so provisioning can start the following week. Please confirm whether you want the effective date set to the amendment-signature date or backdated to 2026-10-25 (we can do either but backdating requires explicit PO language and approval from finance).

Thanks — looping Marissa for account ops coordination.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
